title: Animal Den
description: A hollow beneath gnarled roots reveals an animal's lair. The musky smell is strong, but among the bones and bedding you spot coins and what looks like an old herb pouch. Claw marks on the entrance suggest the occupant is sizeable.

choices.label: Reach in carefully
choices.description: Risk a bite for the best loot.

choices.label: Use a long stick
choices.description: Safer but you'll miss the pouch.

choices.label: Smoke the creature out first
choices.description: Wait for it to flee, then search freely.
